source_guard_scope.run-userspace-qemu.py: Producer enforces post source and binary equality before PASS; separate after-hash fields are absent, not manufactured in this review.
source_guard_scope.run-physical-qemu.py: Producer enforces post source and binary equality before PASS; separate after-hash fields are absent, not manufactured in this review.

limitations: No build, QEMU, child execution, signals, host networking, USB/module/ptrace operation or repository write performed. Only /tmp review script/report are written.

Virtual CDC digests and byte totals were independently reconstructed from known synthetic payloads and checked against raw backend events. HID/serial native-driver success also relies on exact guest assertions; underlying evdev/TTY capture files are not preserved by these older successful runners.

Physical FTDI host raw payload file is not persisted. Review recomputes expected SHA and checks actual recorded sink byte count/SHA, guest exact-byte assertions, and frozen producer enforcement; it does not claim an independent decode of an unavailable raw sink file.

Four printed attach receipts per run prove the two normal cycles and changed reconnect generations. The third hot-phase receipt files are not printed/persisted; same-receipt hot assertions are guest validations, corroborated by the unchanged FTDI slot and increasing real counters, not a new independently deserialized third client receipt.

Hot reinsertion device generation/node changes are explicitly checked by the frozen guest and strict raw marker; full new-device receipt is not persisted by this older harness. Old slot remains Gone and client advertising excludes reinserted HID.
These three regressions are not the new SIGTERM acceptance scenario and do not establish repeated-signal cleanup, SIGKILL recovery, kernel-internal blocking or real hardware support.
